key_insight: Cancer is common across major cardiovascular disease groups, with active cancer prevalence around 4% to 6% and any-cancer prevalence reaching about 14% in atrial fibrillation.
clinical_relevance: These pooled rates suggest cardiovascular patients often have meaningful coexisting cancer burden, supporting coordinated, multidisciplinary care planning.
method: Systematic review and meta-analysis of PubMed, Web of Science, and Scopus from 2010 to July 2024
Included 676 studies with about 180 million participants
Used one-step generalized linear mixed models to pool prevalence estimates across CVD groups and cancer types
evidence_signal: The review analyzed 59 studies for active cancer and reported pooled prevalence estimates with 95% confidence intervals across multiple cardiovascular conditions.
watch_item: Prevalence estimates combine highly heterogeneous observational studies, so rates may not apply equally across settings, populations, or care pathways.
paper_title: Prevalence of cancer in patients with cardiovascular diseases and risk factors: a systematic review and meta-analysis
